findings.issue: Admin tab navigation broken on mobile — sidebar hidden md:block
findings.impact: Admin users on mobile cannot navigate between tabs at all
findings.fix: Add mobile tab bar or dropdown selector for admin sub-pages on screens <768px

findings.issue: Search-bar missing aria-activedescendant on autocomplete input
findings.impact: Screen reader users cannot effectively use search autocomplete
findings.fix: Add role=combobox, aria-expanded, aria-activedescendant to input; role=listbox to results

findings.issue: Formatting bar buttons 28px on mobile fail WCAG 44px touch target minimum
findings.impact: Mobile users struggle to tap small formatting buttons
findings.fix: Increase button size to min 36px (44px preferred) on mobile via responsive classes

findings.issue: Admin page: 150+ hardcoded strings, zero i18n usage
findings.impact: Cannot localize admin interface for non-English users
findings.fix: Extract all UI strings to en.json and use t() function from @/lib/i18n

findings.issue: Settings page: 80+ hardcoded strings, zero i18n usage
findings.impact: Cannot localize settings for non-English users
findings.fix: Extract all UI strings to en.json and use t() function

findings.issue: Search-bar: 50+ hardcoded strings, zero i18n usage
findings.impact: Cannot localize search for non-English users
findings.fix: Extract all UI strings to en.json and use t() function

findings.issue: Settings reset/delete dialogs lack focus traps — Tab escapes backdrop
findings.impact: Keyboard users can interact with page behind confirmation dialogs
findings.fix: Use shared Dialog component from @chat/ui which has built-in focus trap

findings.issue: Channel-info silently catches API failures, returns empty arrays
findings.impact: Silent failure — users see empty data with no indication of error
findings.fix: Surface error state with retry option instead of .catch(() => ({ messages: [] }))

findings.issue: Settings dual save mechanism — auto-save AND Save button confusing
findings.impact: Users confused about whether changes persist
findings.fix: Standardize on one pattern: auto-save with indicator or manual save without auto-save

findings.issue: Language change triggers window.location.reload()
findings.impact: Full page flash on locale change — poor UX
findings.fix: Use router.refresh() or i18n provider locale switch without full reload

findings.issue: No result count shown in search results
findings.impact: Users don't know result set size
findings.fix: Add 'X results found' counter at top of results

findings.issue: Search-bar type dropdown/autocomplete lack role=listbox
findings.impact: Screen readers don't announce list navigation
findings.fix: Add role=listbox to container, role=option to items

findings.issue: Search results container lacks aria-live=polite
findings.impact: Screen reader users get no feedback when results update
findings.fix: Add aria-live=polite to results container

findings.issue: Formatting toolbar no arrow-key navigation — Tab-only through 15 buttons
findings.impact: Inefficient keyboard navigation
findings.fix: Add arrow-key navigation within toolbar

findings.issue: Formatting toolbar buttons lack visible focus ring
findings.impact: Keyboard users can't see focus position
findings.fix: Add focus-visible:ring or outline to all buttons

findings.issue: Link/image formatting buttons have aria-pressed: undefined
findings.impact: Screen reader users don't know if formatting is active
findings.fix: Add aria-pressed={isActive} to toggle buttons

findings.issue: Formatting bar: 20+ hardcoded strings, zero i18n
findings.impact: Cannot localize formatting UI for non-English users
findings.fix: Use t() for button aria-labels and tooltips

findings.issue: Notification preferences modal: 20+ hardcoded strings, zero i18n
findings.impact: Cannot localize notification preferences
findings.fix: Use t() for all modal UI strings

findings.issue: Keyboard shortcuts modal: 25+ hardcoded strings, zero i18n
findings.impact: Cannot localize keyboard shortcuts
findings.fix: Use t() for all shortcut labels and categories

findings.issue: Keyboard shortcuts show 'Ctrl+K' on macOS — no platform detection
findings.impact: Mac users see incorrect modifier labels
findings.fix: Detect platform and show Cmd on macOS, Ctrl on Windows/Linux

findings.issue: Keyboard shortcuts filter has no aria-live for result count
findings.impact: Screen reader users have no feedback when filtering
findings.fix: Add aria-live=polite region for filtered count

findings.issue: All error boundaries (5+ files) lack role=alert
findings.impact: Screen readers may not announce errors
findings.fix: Add role=alert to error message containers in each error.tsx

findings.issue: All loading states (5+ files) lack aria-busy=true / role=status
findings.impact: Screen reader users don't know content is loading
findings.fix: Add aria-busy=true and role=status with aria-live=polite

findings.issue: Root and auth loading show bare spinner instead of layout skeleton
findings.impact: Poor perceived performance; layout shift
findings.fix: Match loading skeleton to actual page layout

findings.issue: Workspace loading skeleton shown on mobile includes sidebar unconditionally
findings.impact: Loading skeleton doesn't match mobile layout
findings.fix: Show mobile-appropriate skeleton on small screens

findings.issue: Onboarding tour has no role=dialog, no focus trap
findings.impact: Keyboard users can Tab behind the tour
findings.fix: Add role=dialog, aria-modal=true, focus trap

findings.issue: Cookie banner has role=dialog but no focus trap and no aria-modal=true
findings.impact: Users can interact behind the consent dialog
findings.fix: Add aria-modal=true and focus trap when visible

findings.issue: Channel-info tab bar missing role=tablist, aria-selected on tabs
findings.impact: Screen readers don't get tab semantics
findings.fix: Add proper ARIA tab pattern: role=tablist, role=tab, aria-selected

findings.issue: Channel-info empty states lack actionable buttons
findings.impact: Dead-end empty states without guidance
findings.fix: Add contextual action buttons (Pin a message, Invite members)

findings.issue: highlightText function duplicated in 2 files
findings.impact: DRY violation — maintenance risk
findings.fix: Extract to shared lib/highlight-text.ts

findings.issue: Pagination logic duplicated across 3 admin tabs
findings.impact: Maintenance burden — bugs fixed 3x
findings.fix: Extract shared Pagination component

findings.issue: Admin stat grid uses grid-cols-2 on mobile — narrow cells
findings.impact: Cramped mobile stats display
findings.fix: Use grid-cols-1 on mobile, grid-cols-2 on sm+

findings.issue: Message list 30-frame RAF loop for initial scroll may jank
findings.impact: Potential jank on low-end devices
findings.fix: Replace with single scrollToIndex call after short delay

findings.issue: Two parallel CSS variable systems (Mattermost + design tokens) active interchangeably
findings.impact: Theming consistency risk
findings.fix: Document component boundaries for each var system; plan consolidation

findings.issue: console.warn used instead of user-facing toast in 50+ catch blocks
findings.impact: Silent failures — users don't see errors
findings.fix: Replace console.warn with addToast for user-visible operations

findings.issue: Dark mode --text-secondary hardcoded rgba instead of using --text-secondary-alpha var
findings.impact: Dark mode opacity differs from design token
findings.fix: Use rgba(var(--center-channel-color-rgb), var(--text-secondary-alpha))
